description: Suggest architectural decisions with advanced prompting techniques (Knowledge Generation + Reflexion). TIP: Read @.mcp-server-context.md first for project history, patterns, and previous ADRs to ensure consistency.

changeDescription.description: Description of the changes (for code_changes analysis)

conversationContext.description: Rich context from the calling LLM about user goals and discussion history

budget.description: Budget or resource constraints (e.g., "limited budget", "enterprise scale")

constraints.description: Limitations, compliance requirements, or restrictions (e.g., ["GDPR compliance", "budget under $50k", "minimal downtime"])

focusAreas.description: Specific areas of concern or interest (e.g., ["security", "performance", "maintainability"])

humanRequest.description: Original human request text for context restoration and knowledge graph storage

previousContext.description: Relevant context from previous conversation (e.g., "User mentioned concerns about database splitting")

timeline.description: Timeline or urgency information (e.g., "launch in 3 months", "urgent migration")

userGoals.description: Primary objectives the user wants to achieve (e.g., ["microservices migration", "improve security"])

userRole.description: User's role or expertise level (e.g., "senior architect", "developer", "project manager")

enhancedMode.description: Enable advanced prompting features (Knowledge Generation + Reflexion)

existingAdrs.description: List of existing ADR titles to avoid duplication

knowledgeEnhancement.description: Enable Knowledge Generation for domain-specific insights

learningEnabled.description: Enable Reflexion learning from past experiences

name: suggest_adrs
